network_interface.tooltip.summary: Interfaces Simulated Sensors to kinetic Battle Networks.
network_interface.tooltip.condition1: When facing a Gimbal, Altitude or Velocity Sensor, or a Navigation Table:
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour1: _Polls_ the sensor at a rate proportional to input RPM.
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour2: _Connects_ the computer to the Battle Network and _drives_ it at the same rate.
network_interface.tooltip.behaviour3: _Connects_ the table: it shows the ship and the computer's plot, and its target goes to the computer.

ballistic_computer.tooltip.summary: The core of the fire control computer: _computes_ firing solutions for Cannon Mounts.
ballistic_computer.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
ballistic_computer.tooltip.behaviour1: _Joins_ that interface's Battle Network, reads its sensors and _sends_ firing solutions to its servos.
ballistic_computer.tooltip.condition2: When modules touch it, directly or through other modules:
ballistic_computer.tooltip.behaviour2: Each kind of module _adds a capability_. The computer's goggles list what is installed and what is missing.

differentiator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out how fast the target is moving.
differentiator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
differentiator.tooltip.behaviour1: The guns _lead_ a moving target, and servos _track smoothly_ instead of lagging behind.

integrator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Keeps the solution running between readings.
integrator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
integrator.tooltip.behaviour1: A rangefinder solution is _held for 10 seconds_ after ranging stops, and the ship's own speed is _compensated_ (needs Velocity Sensors). With a _Differentiator_, the held target keeps moving.

correlator.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Combines several rangefinders.
correlator.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
correlator.tooltip.behaviour1: Rangefinders ranging the _same target_ are _merged_ into one more accurate fix.

fire_mission_console.tooltip.summary: The gunnery officer's station: shows the _fire mission_ and gives the _orders_.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour1: Shows the _target_, the _trajectory_ and each gun's _firing solution_ through Goggles.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition2: When scrolling over the knob on the left:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour2: Sets a _fuze correction_ from -40 to +40 ticks (2 seconds), added to timed fuzes: early for an _airburst_ short of the target, late so a base-fuzed _armour-piercing_ shell bursts _inside_ after piercing. On _delayed impact_ and _delayed inertia_ fuzes it sets the delay after impact instead. Scrolling turns it 5 ticks a notch, or 1 with _Shift_ held; _right-click_ the knob to zero it.
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition3: When the lever in the middle is right-clicked:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.condition4: When the button on the right is right-clicked:
fire_mission_console.tooltip.behaviour4: _Fires_ every gun that has a solution and is _on target_. The others hold fire.

navigation_console.tooltip.summary: Shows the ship's own _attitude_, _speed_ and _altitude_ through Goggles.
navigation_console.tooltip.condition1: When a powered Battle Network Interface faces it:
navigation_console.tooltip.behaviour1: _Shows_ each reading the network has a _sensor_ for: Gimbal, heading, Velocity and Altitude.

fuze_computer.tooltip.summary: A module for the _Ballistic Computer_. Works out fuze times.
fuze_computer.tooltip.condition1: When part of a computer's bank:
fuze_computer.tooltip.behaviour1: _Timed fuzes_ in loaded shells are _set_ to the time of flight.

rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.summary: Carries a _rangefinder_ and trains it towards a bearing.
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.condition1: When facing up or down and right-clicked:
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.behaviour1: _Assembles_ the attached structure. Its turning speed scales with the _network RPM_.
rangefinder_bearing.tooltip.behaviour2: _Illuminates_ the eyepiece reticle. A stronger signal makes it _brighter_.

rangefinder_lens.tooltip.summary: An objective lens for a _rangefinder_ tube. Place _two_ at the ends of the tube, looking the same way.
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.behaviour1: The _further apart_ the lenses, the more _accurate_ the range reading.
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.condition2: When Wrenched on the top or bottom:
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.behaviour2: _Turns_ the lens to face the next direction.
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.condition3: When cracked by blast or a hit:
rangefinder_lens.tooltip.behaviour3: Range readings become _far less accurate_. Right-click the lens with a _Glass Pane_ to repair it.

map_table.tooltip.summary: A plotting table for _maps_. Joins with neighbouring tables into a square of up to _3×3_.
map_table.tooltip.condition1: When right-clicked with a Filled Map:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour1: _Lays_ the map on that part of the table. Maps must share the same zoom and fit together _like the land_, north up.
map_table.tooltip.condition2: When right-clicked with an empty hand:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour2: _Opens_ the table, showing all its maps stitched together. _Right-click_ the maps to mark a _target_.
map_table.tooltip.condition3: When a Battle Network Interface faces it:
map_table.tooltip.behaviour3: _Shows_ the ship's position and _sends_ the marked target to the _Ballistic Computer_.

rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.summary: The operator's station on a _rangefinder_ tube. _Bolts_ onto the back of the tube, _centred_ between the lenses.
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.condition1: When placed on the side of a block:
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.behaviour1: _Mounts_ on that block, looking into it. It moves with the block, and _pops off_ if the block is removed.
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.condition2: When right-clicked on an assembled tube:
rangefinder_eyepiece.tooltip.behaviour2: _Seats_ the player. The tube _follows_ where they look.
